idea-plugin.name: Stagecraft
idea-plugin.description:
A Jenkins build and log viewer for JetBrains IDEs, built around the things that make other Jenkins plugins unusable: folder and multibranch job discovery that actually finds your job, per-stage logs for declarative pipelines, live console output that keeps up, and network failures that say what went wrong instead of freezing the IDE.

Works against Jenkins 2.204.1 LTS and later, with an API token, behind a proxy, and over HTTPS with a certificate you have explicitly trusted.
